sessionStart.powershell: $raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try { $data = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { exit 0 }; $cwd = $data.cwd; if ($cwd -notmatch '^[A-Za-z]:\\Work\\Worktrees\\') { exit 0 }; $cfgPath = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.copilot\config.json'; try { $cfg = Get-Content $cfgPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { exit 0 }; if ($cwd -notin $cfg.trustedFolders) { $cfg.trustedFolders += $cwd; $cfg | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress | Set-Content $cfgPath -Encoding UTF8 }
sessionStart._note: Edit the regex pattern above to match your own worktree root path (e.g. C:\\Dev\\Worktrees\\).
